name: Bayárcal (Spain)
description: White field with a green triangle from the hoist to the centre of the fly, a blue crescent in the upper white and a blue cross in the lower white, with a white castle on the green and a white and blue wavy stripe at the foot.
history: Bayárcal applied to the Junta de Andalucía on 29 August 2006 to register the arms and flag in use, receiving approval in February 2009; the flag is a cloth of 2:3, white with a green triangle based on the hoist and pointing to the centre of the fly, a blue crescent in the upper white triangle and a blue cross in the lower one, with two wavy stripes white and blue.

features.role: triangle from the hoist to the centre of the fly
